title: A true agentic platform built for retail traders
author: Independent-Gap2893
selftext:
My friend and I got so tired of trying to piece together all of these different tools and LLMs, we decided about a year ago to build an all in one AI native platform for retail traders.



You can connect your brokerage, build custom agents and agent teams to do anything you want in markets across research, setup detection, scanning, risk and portfolio monitoring etc without having to manage the systems and pay for expensive market data providers.



Curious to hear what everyone thinks, it's free to try! [https://www.honeyflow.ai](https://www.honeyflow.ai)
